description.describe_ch: 本課程旨在透過選讀、分析及討論國際財經新聞，激發學生對財務金融、永續金融及公司治理議題的興趣，使其了解相關的背景和未來趨勢，並提升商用英語閱讀能力。課程將引導學生掌握專業詞彙，獲得財金議題知識，同時培養學生未來自主閱讀相關文章的能力，以符合產業對於財務之人才需求，及因應實務之挑戰。
description.describe_eh: This course aims to motivate students' interest in finance, sustainable finance, and corporate governance topics through the reading, analysis, and discussion of international financial articles. It will help them understand the related backgrounds and future trends while enhancing their business English reading and expression skills. The course will guide students in mastering professional vocabulary and gaining knowledge about financial issues. Moreover, it will cultivate their ability to independently read related articles in the future, meeting the talent demands of the industry in the field of finance and addressing practical challenges.

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new:
Attendances (25%): Each unexcused absence will result in a deduction of 4 points.
Oral presentation (30%): Personal presentation.
Discussion and interaction (45%): Interacting with the teacher and other students.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
Please behave in a reasonable, responsible and courteous manner.
Please come to class on time. If you are ill or have an emergency, remember to ask for leave. 
If you need to leave class early for any reason, please inform me in advance.
Do not engage in tasks unrelated to the course during class. Except for group discussions, please avoid chatting.
When classmates are presenting or asking questions, please listen carefully. If you are presenting, speak loudly so that everyone can hear you clearly.
Laptops or tablets are allowed for taking notes, but should be put away when not in use.
Please keep your mobile phone or other mobile devices on silent during class.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
Course Policies
1. Be on time.
2. Participate in the class discussion and class activities.
3. Students must submit a leave application to the school in advance, stating the reason for the leave and the expected duration.
4. Please purchase an original textbook, following intellectual property law. 
5. The texts and exercises will be completed in class. Please bring textbooks to class.
6. Follow the school rules to apply for a make-up exam within three days of the exam date. Relevant documents are required for the application. No-shows or those with late applications will receive ZERO. The date of a make-up exam will be arranged by the instructor.
7. Following the FCU Exam Regulations, cheaters will receive ZERO for their exams and such cases will be reviewed by the Student Reward and Disciplinary Committee.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem:
I will announce my weekly office hours in class. 
If you have any questions about the course, please feel free to email me to arrange a time for discussion.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
Learning must be based on integrity. Plagiarism in reports will result in a zero mark.
When you present your report, the text must be your own. If you use the words or ideas of others, please ensure that you cite the sources properly.
Reports submitted under your name are considered your original work and should not have been submitted to another course. As a student, please demonstrate integrity in all academic activities.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
1. Students must exhibit honesty and ethical behavior in their academic activities, avoiding plagiarism and falsification of data.
  2. Plagiarism: Proper citation of sources is required. Copying or using others' work without appropriate attribution is considered plagiarism.
  3. Cheating: Following exam rules is mandatory. Unauthorized materials or collusion with others during exams is considered cheating.
  4. Grading: The final semester grade is based on the principle of fairness. No individual grade adjustments are allowed. Any request that violates fairness—such as asking for special grade changes—is strictly prohibited.
  5. Learning must be based on honesty. Any student who attempts to use a work that he has not produced as his own is considered dishonest. Students who cheat or plagiarize in homework, tests or exams, or assist others, will be scored as zero. If they are repeat offenders, they will be submitted in accordance with the rewards and punishments for students of Feng Chia University.
  6. It is considered cheating if you copy someone else's answers during an assessment, or if you turn in a paper or assignment that was written in whole or in part by someone else when you turned in an assignment.
  7. It is considered cheating if you copy someone else's answers during an assessment, or if you turn in a paper or assignment that was written in whole or in part by someone else when you turned in an assignment.
